name: org.fourthline.cling.android.AndroidUpnpServiceImpl
description: The Cling Android UPnP library starts its device-network engine when this service is created and exposes a device registry and control point to apps that bind it. Apps use these to find and control compatible UPnP or DLNA devices.
disableEffect: Apps that rely on Cling to discover or control local UPnP and DLNA devices lose that device-connection feature.
